title: Spot the Duplicates
briefMd:
# Spot the Duplicates

Before merging two annotation batches, you inspect a **frozen slice** of the training pool:

| id | prompt (truncated) | label (truncated) |
|---|---|---|
| tr-01 | Summarize invoice #4421 | Invoice 4421 totals €120. |
| tr-04 | Summarize invoice #4421 | Invoice 4421 totals €120. |
| tr-02 | Escalate P1 outage ticket | Route to on-call within 5 min. |
| tr-03 | Export GDPR data package | Provide JSON within 30 days. |

Pass when you flag **duplicate** rows and list **both** ids that should be deduped before fine-tuning.
